title: a11y Chrome: CDP overlay + UIA native dialog blocker detection
desc: When a11y click/invoke fails on Chrome with a CSS dialog overlay or native confirm/alert, the blocker is now detected and reported as a BLOCKED grap. Stage 1: UIA tree search for confirm/cancel buttons in Chrome window. Stage 2: CDP z-index>=100 fixed/absolute element covering >5% viewport.
steps: Net result: a11y click/invoke prints specific BLOCKED grap guide instead of silent fail
When a11y target not found on Chrome: call TryReportChromeNativeDialogViaUia then TryReportCdpOverlayBlocker
TryReportChromeNativeDialogViaUia: UIA EnumWindows finds confirm/cancel/OK/Leave buttons in Chrome tree
TryReportCdpOverlayBlocker: CDP JS checks z-index>=100 + position:fixed/absolute + >=5% viewport => BLOCKED grap
EmitBlockerGrap: outputs BLOCKED grap with dismiss button; adds [ELEVATED:needs --sudo] when UIPI detected
InspectionCommands.cs calls both detectors when inspect returns null on Chrome window
a11y capture on blocked Chrome page: blocker detection runs before returning error -- prints BLOCKED grap
author: claude
